keyEvents.text: Mama Baldé (Brest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Isaak Touré (Lorient) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lorient. Aiyegun Tosin replaces Ibrahima Baldé.
Substitution, Lorient. Gabin Bernardeau replaces Souleymane Faye.
Goal! Lorient 0, Brest 1. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Brest. Giovani Versini replaces Kamory Doumbia.
Substitution, Brest. Noah Edjouma replaces Mama Baldé.
Substitution, Lorient. Noah Mbamba replaces Noah Cadiou.
Substitution, Lorient. Théo Le Bris replaces Jean-Victor Makengo.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Brest. Mamady Diambou replaces Pathé Mboup.
Substitution, Lorient. Srdjan Kuzmic replaces Dembo Sylla.
